purpose: Cross-programme evidence inventory; no novel pooled effects, no reclassification of frozen primary outcomes

status_vocab.primary_support: Prospectively selected primary outcome, as qualified by study-specific criteria
status_vocab.qualified_support: Original source and target qualified, with explicit estimator/provenance restriction
status_vocab.retrospective_support: Reanalysis after previous outcomes known, not independent confirmatory test
status_vocab.mixed_or_no_generalization: Positive cross-site/heldout criterion not established or fails; not a biological zero

Full corrected 201 rho/SE table recovered from original job stdout with no source species rows republished; all corrected-row, impact and raw/log sampling-variance checks pass. A re-run of the three unchanged original R models matched all 30 frozen Stage B model statistics exactly (PR #67, Actions #44542568468).
